author: Hayden Sherry
title: Police seeking missing person in Dauphin County - NewsBreak
text:
By Hayden Sherry ,
8 hours ago
DERRY TOWNSHIP, Pa. (WHTM) — Authorities are seeking a missing person last seen in Dauphin County.
Dianne Fraser, according to the Derry Township Police Department, was last seen on foot near East Glenn Road on Tuesday, June 2, at around 2 p.m.
Police say she was last seen wearing a green shirt, black hooded sweatshirt, dark gray jacket, black sweatpants, light blue shoes, and mismatched blue and green socks.
Dianne, police said, was diagnosed with schizophrenia and has not been taking her medication, which has led to delusions. Although she is not known to be violent, police say her condition is a concern, and she is known to walk in local parks.
Dianne Fraser, courtesy of Derry Twp. Police If you have any information about Dianne’s whereabouts or see her, contact the Derry Township Police Department at (717) 534-2202.
